capitals.name: Dvin
capitals.note: Infobox capitals "Dvin, Janza, and Ani" with no years; the spans are the researcher's reading of where the dynasty sat (Dvin 951, Ganja from 971, Ani from 1072).

capitals.name: Ani
capitals.note: "1072: The Seljuks sold Ani to Manuchihr, who founded the Ani emirate."

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Shaddadid row): "951: Muhammad ibn Shaddad established himself at Dvin. He lost it to Musafirid incursion and fled to the Kingdom of Vaspurakan." The page gives no area; the loss has no year, so Dvin is drawn for 951 only.
New keyframe: "971: Lashkari I took Ganja, ending Musafirid influence in Arran." 952-970: no known land.
New keyframe: "1022: Fadl I took Dvin from the Armenian Bagratids." Abu'l-Aswar Shavur's 1049-1067 "zenith" has no extent on the page.
New keyframe: "1072: The Seljuks sold Ani to Manuchihr, who founded the Ani emirate."
New keyframe: "1075: Alp Arslan annexed the last Shaddadid territories" (the page's date; Alp Arslan died in 1072 on other accounts); Ani stays.
New keyframe: "1085-1086: Fadl III seized Ganja, then Malik-Shah removed him."
New keyframe: Ani alone; "1124: David IV of Georgia took Ani without a fight" ends it.
New keyframe: "1125: Fadl IV resumed Shaddadid rule in Ani." "1130: Ani passed to Demetrius I on terms of vassalage" (the dynasty continues as a Georgian vassal; no loss written).
New keyframe: 1161 "Ivane Orbeli was appointed ruler of Ani"; "1164-1174: Shahanshah ruled Ani for about ten years, until George III captured him in 1174"; 1199 Tamar captured Ani.

ledger.note: 951: Muhammad ibn Shaddad establishes the Shaddadids at Dvin. 'Muhammad ibn Shaddad established himself at Dvin. He lost it to Musafirid incursion and fled to the Kingdom of Vaspurakan' (infobox established 951; the Sallarid page has the Shaddadids taking the Dvin area in 948).
952: Dvin lost. 'He lost it to Musafirid incursion and fled to the Kingdom of Vaspurakan'; the page gives no year, 952 is bridging.
971: Lashkari I takes Ganja. '971: Lashkari I took Ganja, ending Musafirid influence in Arran.'
1022: Fadl I takes Dvin. '1022: Fadl I took Dvin from the Armenian Bagratids.'
1072: the Seljuks sell Ani to Manuchihr, who founds the Ani emirate.

region.text: the last Shaddadid territories in Arran and Dvin

ledger.note: 1075: 'Alp Arslan annexed the last Shaddadid territories' (the Ganja and Dvin lands); the page gives 1075 although Alp Arslan is dated 1072 elsewhere. 1068-1069 Ashot ruled Arran for eight months minting in Alp Arslan's name.
1086: Malik-Shah removes Fadl III from Ganja.
1124: David IV of Georgia takes Ani. 'David IV of Georgia took Ani without a fight. Abu'l-Aswar Shavur II was captured.'
1125: Fadl IV resumes Shaddadid rule in Ani.

1161: George III's general Ivane Orbeli is appointed ruler of Ani. The page does not say what became of the Shaddadid emir; 1130 'Ani passed to Demetrius I on terms of vassalage' is not drawn as a loss.
1164: Shahanshah rules Ani. '1164-1174: Shahanshah ruled Ani for about ten years, until George III captured him in 1174.' The page does not say Shahanshah was a Shaddadid or how he regained the city.
1199: Queen Tamar takes Ani. '1199: Queen Tamar captured Ani and gave it to the Mkhargrzeli family. This ended the Shaddadids.'
1199: the Shaddadids end with the Georgian capture of Ani.

wars.name: Shaddadid wars against the Byzantines
wars.outcome: "1047-1057: The Shaddadids fought several wars against the Byzantine army." No border change is dated.

wars.name: Seljuk annexation of the Shaddadids
wars.outcome: Abu'l-Aswar Shavur (1049-1067) was "the last independent emir, before Tughril I demanded vassalage"; Ashot minted in Alp Arslan's name in 1068-1069 and Alp Arslan annexed the last territories in 1075.
wars.note: The page does not mention a 1064 campaign; 1064 is not used, the war is dated by the 1068-1069 coinage and 1075.

wars.name: Georgian conquest of Ani
wars.outcome: David IV took Ani in 1124, Fadl IV resumed in 1125, Ani passed to Demetrius I as a vassal in 1130, Ivane Orbeli was appointed in 1161, Shahanshah ruled 1164-1174 and Tamar ended the dynasty in 1199.

certainty.note: City emirates (Dvin, Ganja, Ani) with no frontiers on the page; the Ani circle is the sharpest, the Arran lands the vaguest.

sources.title: Shaddadids

notes: Cliopatria has no Shaddadid row. Wikidata id not known; left null. No area on the page. The Ganja branch is only partly dated: Fadl III 1085-1086, the Eldiguzid sultan 'retook Ganja' 1143 and Fadl V 1155-1161 imply Shaddadid rule in Ganja that no year opens: no event is written for those and Ganja is not drawn after 1086. Dvin: Fadl IV/Qurti c. 1030 passage conflicts with the 1022 gain (page), not used. Vassalage: a cadet line received Ani and Tbilisi 'as a reward for their service to the Seljuqs', Abu'l-Aswar had to accept Tughril's vassalage, and Ani was a Georgian vassal from 1130: these are Shaddadid vassalage for the suzerain's dossier, not events here. The Rawadids are not mentioned on the Shaddadid page. Counterparts: sallarid-dynasty (written here), bagratid-armenia (eu-19), kingdom-of-georgia (eu-19), great-seljuk-empire (me-09), the Eldiguzids (me-09-x). Gazetteer names needed: Dvin, Ani, Janza/Ganja region.
